stats.reference: Hero Rank Level 1, no gear or temporary buffs; playable starting owned Manifestation, not LN23 canonical existence value
stats.curve: R(r)=10^(0.4r+0.04r^2); resolved stat = seed*R(r)^alpha, no within-rank gain at L1
stats.interpretation: HP 8455 / ATK 4103 / DEF 1219 at entry. DEF ~30% of ATK; defense weaker than heal/sustain. Rank growth uses the frozen coefficient at r=4; high future numbers require actual Rank progress, not automatically Absolute.
stats.precision_note: Integer magnitudes calculated with Decimal exponent at reference Rank. Percentage fields are bps (10000=100%). Each scripted effect resolves via core math and rule priority, not an unrestricted baked multiplier.
stats.no_unregistered_resistances: No blood/holy/dark/fire/poison/spirit/soul/wound/control resistance defined unless there is an actual registered content effect family; Native FOGCombatStats supports CritRateResistance, CritDamageResistance and TrueDamageResistance only. No random innate elemental resistances invented.
stats.scaling_note: Absolute is a Transcendence grade, not a Rank or Level; no predefined Absolute Lv100 numerical template. Separate source power from owned Manifestation progression.

mechanical_rules.attempt: negate exactly one eligible content-ID effect instance; descending eligible potency then stable lexical ContentId tie-break

mechanical_rules.fail: marks consumed only on successful contest; marks remain on blocked contest, still damage normally

mechanical_rules.fail: Dawn Oath stays; existing heal reduction/inversion still applies; no fabricated cure
mechanical_rules.visual_success: gold-white rose grows through narrow red restriction chain, breaking one chain link
mechanical_rules.visual_failure: gold thread reaches barrier then scatters as black glass

effect_taxonomy.rules: Do not invent status resistance statistics. Parent families are semantic mechanic types, not automatically registered canonical IDs. An actual handler must validate immunity/content eligibility.

Bleed.default_rule: A Bleed variant author defines source stat, tick rate, stacks, duration, damage type, cleanse and status applicability. No invented universal per-target Bleed Resistance stat.

AttackUp.rule: Add bonus to resolved Attack for authored duration and stack limit; not a global innate stat.

SpeedUp.rule: Resolve SPD change through executor timing adapter; never mutate an already pending ordered action without authored rule.

HealingReceivedUp.rule: Multiplies legitimate direct restoration on target; does not modify HP-loss siphon unless authored.

DamageTakenReduction.rule: Reduces ordinary eligible damage in own multiplier category; not same as DEF or a new resistance stat.

Shield.rule: Temporary separate barrier with existing shield/extra HP resolution; not silently added as permanent MaxHP.

Marked.rule: Does not imply Bleed, poison, fire or damage on its own.

RevivalPrepared.rule: Armed before defeat; resolves during defeat/revival window with valid soul and once-per-encounter ledger.

Hemorrhage.tick_source: OnSourceOwnerTurnStart OR 5-second World timer; mutually exclusive per executor clock, not both
